i.norm: Verifies that {@link DayOfYear#query(TemporalQuery)} delegates to a custom (non-built-in) query, returning exactly whatever that query produces. Here a mocked query is stubbed to echo back the same DayOfYear it is asked about, so the result must be that DayOfYear, value 45 (the mocked "today").
A custom query stubbed to return the DayOfYear it is queried from.
